entities.name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Provides mutual authentication between UE and network and agrees on keys KAUSF, KSEAF, and KAMF. Always initiated and controlled by the network.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Transports EAP-request message, ngKSI, and ABBA from network to UE as part of EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Transports EAP-response message from UE to network as part of EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Transports EAP-success message and ngKSI from network to UE when AMF intends to initiate security mode control procedure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: Transports EAP-success or EAP-failure message and ngKSI from network to UE when AMF does not intend security mode control.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Transports EAP-failure message from network to UE in case of unsuccessful authentication.

entities.name: EAP-request message
entities.description: EAP message type sent from network to UE to initiate authentication exchange.

entities.name: EAP-response message
entities.description: EAP message type sent from UE to network in response to EAP-request.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP message type indicating successful authentication completion.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP message type indicating unsuccessful authentication completion.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key Set Identifier for 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: T3560
entities.description: Authenticator retransmission timer for EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context created by EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure.

relations.description: Procedure uses AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to transport EAP-request.
Procedure uses AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message to transport EAP-response.
Message contains EAP-success information element when security mode control is intended.
Message contains EAP-success information element when security mode control is not intended.
Message contains EAP-failure information element for unsuccessful authentication.
Message contains EAP-failure information element for unsuccessful authentication.
Sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST starts timer T3560.
Receiving AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE stops timer T3560.
Procedure creates partial native 5G NAS security context.
